feed.title: Windhawk Mod Updates
feed.subtitle: Updates in the official collection of Windhawk mods

entry.title: Alt.Binz Dark Mode 1.0.2
entry.content:
• New setting "Title bar color" (default black, Windows 11 only): colors the window title bars of Alt.Binz. Leave it empty to keep the color of Windows.
  • New setting "List text color" for the text and lines in the download queue and the log. Without it the text color is used.
  • New setting "Column text color" for the text of the column headers.
  • The text colors are applied live, without restarting Alt.Binz, and can now be dark (they were limited to at least 50% lightness before).

entry.title: Taskbar Snipper 1.2.0
entry.content:
• The screenshot and record buttons are part of the taskbar's own layout now, which makes room for them, rather than a window placed over it. The new Position setting puts them left of the notification area, of the Wi-Fi, volume and battery icons, or of the clock, or at the left end of the taskbar. They're no longer dragged.
  • With Taskbar Audio Flipper or Taskbar RDP Launcher in the same position, the widgets sit side by side: Move left and Move right in the right-click menu change their order. They replace Link widgets.
  • The menu is Windows' own XAML menu.
  • The mod needs Windows 11 now. The first time it starts, Windhawk downloads the taskbar's symbols.

entry.title: Taskbar RDP Launcher 1.3.0
entry.content:
• The widget is part of the taskbar's own layout now, which makes room for it, rather than a window placed over it. The new Position setting puts it left of the notification area, of the Wi-Fi, volume and battery icons, or of the clock, or at the left end of the taskbar. It's no longer dragged.
  • With Taskbar Snipper or Taskbar Audio Flipper in the same position, the widgets sit side by side: Move left and Move right in the right-click menu change their order. They replace Link widgets.
  • The display map is a XAML flyout, opened by hovering a number and closed once the mouse moves off it and the number, and the menu is Windows' own XAML menu.
  • The computer's name and address are as wide as their text, without a divider.
  • The mod needs Windows 11 now. The first time it starts, Windhawk downloads the taskbar's symbols.

entry.title: Taskbar Audio Flipper 1.3.0
entry.content:
• The widget is part of the taskbar's own layout now, which makes room for it, rather than a window placed over it. The new Position setting puts it left of the notification area, of the Wi-Fi, volume and battery icons, or of the clock, or at the left end of the taskbar. It's no longer dragged.
  • With Taskbar Snipper or Taskbar RDP Launcher in the same position, the widgets sit side by side: Move left and Move right in the right-click menu change their order. They replace Link widgets.
  • The output's volume flyout has a volume mixer, like Windows': each app using the output, with its icon (click it to mute the app) and its volume, a gear for Windows' volume mixer settings, and More volume settings. The input's has More sound settings.
  • The flyouts and menus are Windows' own XAML ones, and the flyout closes once the mouse moves off it and its section.
  • Each section is as wide as its text, without dividers.

entry.title: Win+E Reuse File Explorer 1.0.0
entry.content:
Win+E Reuse File Explorer

Press Win+E to bring the most recently active File Explorer window forward. Minimized windows are restored. If Explorer is already focused, it stays focused.

If no Explorer window exists on the current virtual desktop, Windows handles Win+E normally and opens a new window. Extra modifiers (Ctrl, Shift, or Alt) are left unchanged. There are no settings.

entry.title: Hide Taskbar Tooltips 1.4.0
entry.content:
• Added instant hover delay option (-1) and custom delay support (1 to 10000 ms) for visible tooltips.
  • The hover delay is now the total delay instead of an extra delay on top of native timing. If you set it before 1.4.0, adjust it.
  • Confined hover delay overrides strictly to the taskbar thread and Windows.UI.Xaml.dll.
  • Cleaned up README and settings documentation.

entry.title: Notification Center Follows Taskbar 1.0.0
entry.content:
Notification Center Follows Taskbar

Keeps the Windows 11 Notification Center (Win+N, including its calendar) correctly positioned with top, bottom, left, and right taskbars. Detects the taskbar on the flyout's monitor automatically. Adds the missing correction for top taskbars, with an 8 logical pixel vertical gap; retains the horizontal position chosen by Windows or other mods. Auto-hidden taskbars use the monitor's working area.

Install alongside your taskbar positioning mod. Close and reopen Notification Center after enabling, disabling, or moving the taskbar.

Enable Swap notifications and calendar to put the calendar above the notifications. The panels exchange their visual positions while Windows keeps control of their native layout sizes and scrolling. The combined outer bounds stay fixed: the swap doesn't move the host window or change row definitions. No fixed notification height is used. Expanding/collapsing the calendar and changing display size use Windows' normal layout calculations.

Remove any Notification Center Styler rules that swap these panels or force their heights, row definitions, or row positions before enabling this option. Cosmetic styling can remain. Switching the option off restores the original transforms, including bindings. The positioning fix works without the swap.

Other positioning mods

The top-taskbar fix changes only Y by default, so horizontal alignment from Shell Flyout Positions is preserved. This mod and Shell Flyout Positions both observe the flyout being uncloaked; they should not both force its X coordinate.

Repair right-edge position after Explorer restarts is optional. It forces right alignment for top taskbars and overrides a left/center alignment selected in another mod. Leave it off when using Shell Flyout Positions. It is retained because we observed a surviving shell host occasionally reopening on the left after Explorer/taskbar recreation; forcing right alignment corrected that case.

ShellExperienceHost loads this mod only while panel swapping is enabled. Window creation only schedules initialization; XAML is accessed later on its UI thread.

entry.title: Everything & Power Tools in the Start Menu 2.1
entry.content:
• Update Apps results independently of file searches. Move catalog rebuilding and icon loading off the matching worker, reuse app-card controls, preserve selection during background updates, and keep existing file results visible until replacements arrive.
  • Warm the local app, Settings and installed-program catalogs in the background while keeping search UI creation deferred. Refresh app lists after desktop-program registry changes, Store/MSIX package events and Start-menu shortcut changes.
  • Include installed programs and packages without registered launchers, with friendly names, package logos and a “No launcher found” label. Add installation-folder and copy-path actions, and use exact registrations for confirmed uninstall actions.
  • Recognize missing launchers conservatively through matching executable and product metadata. Merge differently named installation records and shortcuts using their executable identity and installation folder while preserving original shortcut actions.
  • Add weather cards with automatic or configured locations, past days, forecasts and a highlighted Today column. Support saved locations and multiple weather cards.
  • Add online currency and cryptocurrency quotes, conversions and configurable saved lists. Keep online cards off by default for new installations; after enabling them, load weather and prices automatically after a short typing pause, with cached results shown immediately. Keep requests separate from local searches and document provider requests and approximate-location privacy.
  • Add a LibreSpeed-based connection test with latency, download and upload readings, an animated speedometer, adaptive transfer timing, cancellation and bounded request pacing. Display Mbps alongside automatic kB/s, MB/s or GB/s readings. Require Run or Enter, limit transfer payloads, reduce limits on metered connections, and preserve the last completed result when a test is cancelled or search closes.
  • Add live /usage cards for CPU, memory, GPUs, disk activity and network traffic, including per-adapter video-memory readings and one-second graphs while visible.
  • Add /services search and service details, with available Start, Stop and Restart actions and administrator elevation when required.
  • Improve clean shutdown of background catalog and service workers, run package-logo decoding on a compatible worker, and avoid network-drive existence checks during catalog rebuilding. Keep settings-triggered catalog refreshes on the helper thread to avoid a race with failed window startup and worker destruction.
  • Add configurable Quick Tools command names, including /ip, and detect duplicate names across tools and custom slash commands. Update tool text across all 50 interface languages and expand the README.

entry.title: Explorer Custom Shortcuts 1.8.0
entry.content:
• Added desktop background support: shortcuts can now work directly on the desktop wallpaper and icons (disabled by default in settings).
  • Added Public Desktop collision checks to prevent duplicate item naming conflicts when creating new files or folders.
  • Added automatic quote and whitespace trimming for shortcut executable paths and internal command inputs.
  • Updated internal:openRecycleBin to open in a new window when triggered from the desktop.
  • Updated internal:openParentFolder to show an error notification when triggered at the desktop or root folder.
  • Fixed toast notification centering on multi-monitor setups when triggered on the desktop.
  • Fixed Alt-key focus cycling to preserve desktop item selection.
  • Updated README documentation with animated previews and desktop usage details.

entry.title: Enter to Rename in File Explorer 0.5.0
entry.content:
Extends Enter-to-rename support to selected desktop files and folders in version 0.5.0.

Desktop support is enabled by default and can be disabled in the mod settings. It applies only to the focused desktop icon list with a nonempty selection. Existing File Explorer behavior is preserved, and Open/Save dialogs remain unaffected.

Validation:

  • Passed compilation checks with the bundled Windhawk compiler.

  • Passed automated checks for desktop detection, modifiers, held Enter, key-up handling, and rename confirmation.

  • Manually tested on Windows 11: desktop rename, confirmation and cancellation, held Enter, settings changes, and existing Explorer behavior.

  • Added Enter-to-rename support for selected desktop files and folders.

  • Added a setting to disable desktop support, which is enabled by default.

entry.title: Windows 8.1 Start Screen Recreation 1.1.0
entry.content:
• Improved the compatibility with StartAllBack (best-effort)
  • Improved the graphics of the tiles
  • Improved the animations of the Start Screen
  • Fixed a defect with the search charm
  • Fixed a minor defect with the names of the tiles going off-screen
  • Improved the search's algorithm
  • Improved the animation of the search charm

entry.title: Explorer Column View 0.57
entry.content:
• Add configurable native column views and a separate This PC view, including Tiles and Content.
  • Add optional double-click/Enter folder expansion while keeping keyboard navigation and selection-based previews.
  • Share the latest automatic layout and exact icon size across columns and remember it for future windows.
  • Route the top View menu to the focused column and preserve manual views through unrelated settings saves.
  • Organize settings with clearer labels and a Browsing section while retaining existing preferences.
  • Add configurable default column widths, optional Fit window sizing and remembered manual widths across windows.
  • Keep Inspector space, held gestures and viewport position stable during fitting; clear saved widths when remembering is disabled.
  • Offer valid divider grab-area choices and enable the checked x64 build-26300 menu path with classic fallback.
  • Add a Hide Inspector switch that stops previews, frees the space and restores the selected file when shown again.
  • Improve Inspector text/control contrast with light and dark transparent backgrounds.
  • Keep displayed bitmap previews opaque while preserving the surrounding glass background.

entry.title: SnapSentry 0.22.0
entry.content:
• Before deleting or recycling a screenshot, SnapSentry now checks that it is still the same file with the same contents it copied. A file replaced or edited during the countdown is kept.
  • Each new screenshot is copied straight away instead of waiting behind earlier countdowns. Popups still appear one at a time.
  • Renaming uses the window that was in front when the screenshot appeared, not when it was processed. If another program briefly holds the new file, SnapSentry waits a moment for it rather than skipping the rename.
  • Clipboard writes use a proper owner window and retry briefly when another app holds the clipboard.
  • File and Path modes no longer offer a Delete button, since the clipboard still points at the file.
  • Very large images are left alone, and the number of screenshots waiting at once is limited.
  • New Capture sessions option: start a session from the tray icon or Ctrl+Alt+F8 (any of F1 to F11), then review, include or leave out, reorder and caption the screenshots, and export them as a packet of numbered copies with a contact sheet and a Markdown page. Export runs in the background, and session screenshots are never deleted.
  • The readme now notes that Windows forgets a "notifications off" choice for SnapSentry when the mod is disabled or updated.

entry.title: Taskbar Clock to Left 2.3.15
entry.content:
• Place only the native clock/notification button in a dedicated left-side container while preserving its text, calendar and notification interactions.
  • Follow readable native system-tray background, border and spacing properties, with asymmetric decoration facing the left screen edge.
  • Keep clear of fixed system buttons and application buttons without moving applications or reserving their viewport.
  • Restore the native clock when placement is unsafe and retry when effective space, text size or layout changes.
  • Support one or two clock text lines; return three or more lines to the native position.
  • Limit relocation to single-monitor desktops, keep native waiting observers while multiple monitors are connected, and retry when returning to one monitor even if the layout dimensions are unchanged.
  • Remove the internal settings and the earlier experimental tray-group migration and viewport-reservation paths.

entry.title: PaintShop Pro Dark Mode 2.0.0
entry.content:
• Renamed to "PaintShop Pro Dark Mode"; it now darkens the whole interface, not only the image windows.
  • New setting: interface darkness for the dark gray surfaces (tool bars, tool column, palettes, tool options bar, dialogs and the area around the color wheel).
  • New setting: title bar color of the main window (black by default).
  • New setting: accent color that replaces the orange of the "Edit" tab and of the line below the title bar.
  • New setting: hide the eight start tiles in the empty workspace (off by default).
  • Image window frames and the flash fix are unchanged.

entry.title: Separate System Tray Icons 1.1.0
entry.content:
Separate System Tray Icons v1.1.0

  • Network, sound, and battery buttons now read Windows native taskbar glyphs and layers. Button and hover-highlight dimensions follow native taskbar sizing and layout, improving consistency across taskbar sizes and orientations. Battery rendering no longer requires manually installing its font.
  • Added Swap troubleshooting position for context menus.
  • Added Show master volume slider in Sound output flyout.
  • Added Show leaf icon in Energy saver mode.
  • Added custom middle-click actions across all buttons.
  • Trigger Project flyout using the Control Center button.
  • Added vertical stacking for the Battery glyph and percentage, adjusted spacing and centering.
  • Kept the Battery glyph working through taskbar size and position changes without restarting Explorer.
  • Fixed Energy saver and percentage items remaining greyed out when enabling Energy saver.
  • Added settings to define horizontal and vertical padding.

entry.title: Fix Task Manager Details Icon Size 0.1
entry.content:
Fix Task Manager Icon Sizes

This mod lets you configure the Task Manager Details/Services icon sizes. You need to restart the task manager after modifying the settings.

I don't know from which version of Windows 11 onwards, the icons on the details page have become as small as ants.

entry.title: DynamicDock 1.0.1
entry.content: • Readme is updated to list other mods for compatible use with this mod.

entry.title: Alt.Binz Dark Mode 1.0.1
entry.content:
• Faster window resizing: the per-pixel color mapping is cached, skin tinting uses a lookup table, and the temporary bitmap for blits is reused instead of being created for every blit (about 2.4 times faster in a resize benchmark, 333 ms to 140 ms per step).
  • The classification of the calling module is cached per address.

entry.title: Radial Window Switcher 1.0.0
entry.content:
Radial Window Switcher

Replaces the standard Alt+Tab with a radial switcher: the icons of open windows are arranged in a ring in the center of the screen, the name of the selected app is shown in the middle, and a live preview of the selected window appears next to its sector.

Usage

  • Hold Alt and press Tab to open the ring.
  • While holding Alt, press Tab for the next window, Shift+Tab for the previous one. Arrow keys also work.
  • Release Alt to switch to the selected window.
  • Press Esc to close the ring without switching.
  • A quick Alt+Tab switches to the previous window, just like the standard one.

Features

  • Smooth animations: the ring spins in, sectors pop out one by one, the selection glows and a pointer glides to the selected app.
  • Live window previews (DWM thumbnails), like the standard Alt+Tab.
  • The selected sector uses the Windows accent color.
  • Per-monitor DPI aware; the ring opens on the monitor with the cursor.
  • Can use Alt+` or Alt+Q instead of Alt+Tab, keeping the standard switcher.

Notes

  • The switcher runs in its own Windhawk process. Only a small part runs in Explorer: it catches Explorer's Alt+Tab hotkey and hands it to the switcher, so the standard switcher doesn't open as well.
  • Minimized windows have no preview: Windows doesn't render them.
  • Alt+` and Alt+Q can't be caught while an elevated (administrator) window is in the foreground. Alt+Tab works there too, through Explorer.
